title: Who Verifies the Tools? How Warped Formatters Mislead Agents and Their Verifiers
title_zh: 谁来验证工具？扭曲的格式化器如何误导智能体及其验证器

paragraphs.en: Agents and verifiers often rely on the text a tool prints, and that text can misrepresent what the tool actually did, even when the tool’s computation is correct. We saw this happen in a production RAG research system used by the Pilsudski Institute in New York, where tool output formatters misled an agent into giving wrong or incomplete information to users. Each tool did its job correctly, but its output omitted search limits, result caps, or identifier namespaces. We also recreated an unlabeled estimate caught in code review before release. We studied whether these formatters misled agents and verifiers and how much the repaired wording helps. We fed tool results to agents using two formatter versions: one with the key omissions and one with all missing details clearly stated. That difference alone changed what the agents claimed and what the verifiers accepted. Unsupported agent claims dropped substantially for three of the four failure types. In one test, verifiers went from accepting incorrect answers 90 out of 90 times to rejecting them 90 out of 90 times. A control showed the verifiers could catch the errors once they were given the missing facts and asked to judge correctness. We include the audit prompt we used with Codex and Claude Code in an exploratory demonstration, written with prior knowledge of our own system’s defects. When pointed at an old version of our own system, it rediscovered the defects that were still live and surfaced twelve more we had not catalogued. When pointed at OpenClaw and Hermes, two of the best-known open-source agentic systems, it found warped formatters in both. We opened PRs to fix both, and the OpenClaw fix has already been merged. Practitioners can run the same prompt on their own systems today.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体和验证器往往依赖工具打印的文本，而这些文本可能错误地描述工具实际做了什么，即使工具的计算本身是正确的。 我们在纽约 Pilsudski 研究所使用的一个生产级 RAG 研究系统中观察到这种情况：工具输出的格式化文本误导智能体向用户提供了错误或不完整的信息。 每个工具都正确地完成了自己的工作，但其输出遗漏了搜索限制、结果上限或标识符命名空间。 我们还复现了一个在发布前的代码审查中被发现的未标注估计值。 我们研究了这些格式化输出是否误导了智能体和验证器，以及修复后的措辞能带来多大帮助。 我们向智能体输入了两个版本的格式化工具结果：一个包含关键遗漏，另一个明确陈述了所有缺失的细节。 仅这一差异就改变了智能体的声明内容和验证器接受的内容。 在四类失败中有三类，智能体的无依据声明大幅下降。 在一项测试中，验证器从 90 次全部接受错误答案，变为 90 次全部拒绝错误答案。 一个对照实验表明，一旦向验证器提供缺失的事实并要求其判断正确性，它们就能发现这些错误。 我们在一项探索性演示中附上了与 Codex 和 Claude Code 配合使用的审计提示词，该提示词是在事先知晓我们自身系统缺陷的情况下编写的。 当把该提示词指向我们自己系统的旧版本时，它重新发现了仍然存在的缺陷，并找出了另外十二个我们尚未记录的缺陷。 当把该提示词指向 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 这两个最著名的开源智能体系统时，它在两者中都发现了失真的格式化输出。 我们提交了修复两者的 PR，其中 OpenClaw 的修复已被合并。 从业者今天就可以在自己的系统上运行同样的提示词。

paragraphs.en: A user asks a production research agent to search an archive for records from a year. Its database contains 4,772 matching documents, but the tool only returns up to 20. In the tool’s own words, the output begins “Found 20 document(s)”, then lists them. Every sentence it prints is true. It did find 20 documents. It just did not specify that they were the first 20 of 4,772. The agent does not have direct access to the database, nor does it have access to the codebase to see the cap in the code. All it has is the words returned by the tool. So it reviews the 20 documents and moves on, completely oblivious to the mountain of unexplored results just behind that limit.
paragraphs.zh: 用户要求一个生产级研究智能体在档案库中搜索某一年份的记录。 其数据库中包含 4,772 份匹配文档，但该工具最多只返回 20 份。 用该工具自己的话说，输出以「找到 20 份文档」开头，然后列出它们。 它打印的每一句话都是真的。 它确实找到了 20 份文档。 它只是没有说明这些文档是 4,772 份中的前 20 份。 该智能体无法直接访问数据库，也无法访问代码库以查看代码中的上限。 它所拥有的只有工具返回的文字。 于是它审阅了这 20 份文档便继续前进，完全没有意识到在那个限制背后还有大量未经探索的结果。

paragraphs.en: How do we catch this? A typical verifier cannot help because it would not have database and codebase access either. It would simply compare the agent’s answer to the data returned by the tool and conclude that it was accurate. And with the information given, the verifier would be right. Neither agents nor verifiers can recover a fact that the tool’s formatter simply leaves out. We call a formatter like this warped: the tool worked, and the wording bent the picture of what it did.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何发现这一点？ 典型的验证器帮不上忙，因为它同样没有数据库和代码库的访问权限。 它只会把智能体的答案与工具返回的数据进行比较，然后得出结论说答案是准确的。 而就所给出的信息而言，验证器的判断是对的。 无论是智能体还是验证器，都无法恢复工具的格式化程序直接遗漏的事实。 我们把这样的格式化程序称为「扭曲的」：工具本身正常工作，但措辞歪曲了它所做之事的图景。

paragraphs.en: Other outputs from the same production system had related failures. An in-document search said “Searched the FULL text” after scanning no more than 1,000,000 characters. The system could present an estimated page number as if confirmed when the label was absent. Separate document and scan numbering let a document number resolve as a valid scan number for a different item. The deployed defects and reconstructed cases motivated the study. They did not establish how the wording affects agent claims or verifier judgments more generally.
paragraphs.zh: 同一生产系统的其他输出也出现了相关的故障。 一项文档内搜索在扫描不超过 1,000,000 个字符后，声称“已搜索全文”。 当标签缺失时，系统可能把一个估计的页码当作已确认的页码来呈现。 文档编号与扫描件编号相互独立，使得某个文档编号可能被解析为另一个条目的有效扫描件编号。 这些已部署的缺陷与重构的案例促成了本研究。 他们并未确立这种措辞在更普遍的层面上会如何影响智能体的陈述或验证者的判断。

paragraphs.en: We asked whether changing the wording of a fixed tool result changes what agents claim and what verifiers accept. We paired each incomplete description with a description of the same result that stated its scope, completeness, uncertainty, or identifier source. Agents answered from the output, and verifiers judged whether the answers were supported. The method stated what each output had to disclose, and a checker used fixed rules to verify which disclosures were present.
paragraphs.zh: 我们询问的是，改变一个固定工具结果的措辞是否会改变智能体的陈述内容以及验证者接受的内容。 我们将每个不完整的描述与同一结果的另一描述配对，后者说明了其范围、完整性、不确定性或标识符来源。 智能体根据输出作答，验证者判断答案是否有依据。 该方法说明了每个输出必须披露的内容，并由检查器使用固定规则验证哪些披露内容确实存在。

paragraphs.en: We collected 1,200 agent runs across three model families. Adding the missing information reduced unsupported agent claims by 62 to 92 percentage points for search coverage, result totals, and estimated values. Agents continued to reuse document numbers as scan numbers despite labels that named the numbering system. In a fixed-answer measure, the paired wording changed all 90 verifier verdicts, 30 unsupported answers each judged by three verifiers, from acceptance to rejection. These agent-side effects apply to the complete repaired wording, which combines factual disclosures with behavioral instructions; they do not isolate disclosure alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们收集了横跨三个模型系列的 1,200 次智能体运行记录。 补充缺失信息后，在搜索覆盖率、结果总数和估计值方面，智能体的无依据声明减少了 62 到 92 个百分点。 尽管标签已明确说明该编号体系的名称，智能体仍继续将文档编号误用作扫描编号。 在固定答案的测量中，成对措辞使全部 90 个验证器判定（每个验证器判定 30 个无依据答案中的 30 个，共 30 个答案由三个验证器分别评判）从接受变为拒绝。 这些智能体侧效应适用于完整的修复后措辞，该措辞将事实披露与行为指令相结合；它们并未单独隔离披露的作用。

paragraphs.en: The production system we audited is a deployed research assistant for a digitized historical archive of 17,807 documents. Its agents query the archive through tools. A tool output formatter is the code that turns a tool implementation’s internal result into the text a model reads. Below, we call this code the formatter. Our audit of the formatter layer found four defect families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们审计的生产系统是一个面向包含 17,807 份文档的数字化历史档案库的已部署研究助手。 其智能体通过工具查询该档案库。 工具输出格式化器是将工具实现的内部结果转换为模型所读取文本的代码。 下文中，我们将这段代码称为格式化器。 我们对格式化器层的审计发现了四类缺陷家族。

paragraphs.en: The first is a scope defect, where the tool claims to have more coverage than it really does. For example, the find_in_document tool could report a false absence. The tool inspected at most the first 1,000,000 characters of each searched field. Although found matches carried a notice when this limit applied, a miss said “Searched the FULL text” and omitted the limit. The archive contained 14 documents with at least one transcript longer than the cap. In 7 of the 14, at least one term first appeared beyond the limit and nowhere before it in any field searched. A query for such a term returned no hit even though the unsearched text contained it. For one reproduced query, the term began at character position 1,000,072 in a 1,031,201-character transcript.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种是范围缺陷，即工具声称的覆盖范围比实际更大。 例如，find_in_document 工具可能报告虚假的「未找到」。 该工具最多只检查每个被搜索字段的前 1,000,000 个字符。 尽管当达到该限制时，找到的匹配会附带提示，但未找到时却显示「已搜索全文」，并且省略了该限制说明。 该档案库包含 14 份文档，其中至少有一份转录文本的长度超过了该上限。 在这 14 份中有 7 份，至少有一个词首次出现在限制范围之外，且在所搜索的任何字段中在此之前的任何位置都没有出现过。 对这类词的查询会返回无结果，即使未被搜索的文本中包含该词。 在一个复现的查询中，该词出现在一份 1,031,201 字符的转录文本的第 1,000,072 个字符位置。

paragraphs.en: The second defect type is completeness. The keyword_search tool had a configurable limit for results. The tool was attached to the RAG agent with a sane 10 result limit for efficiency. However, the formatter downstream had no access to the total number of results in the database, only the results which actually got fetched. It began the output by counting what had been fetched: “Found 10 document(s)”. In the production incident behind this study, 191 documents actually matched the search, and nothing in the output said so. Every statement in the output was technically true, but the truncated list read as the complete result set, and treating it that way contributed to an agent giving incorrect information to a user. Maintainers fixed that formatter in ordinary development. A similar defect was found in the date_range_search tool when starting this research paper: it fetched at most 20 results, its formatter opened with “Found 20 document(s)”, and for the year 1920 the archive actually held 4,772 matches; 90 distinct years had more matches than one fetch could return. Section 3 studies that instance.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种缺陷类型是完整性。 keyword_search 工具有一个可配置的结果数量上限。 该工具被挂载到 RAG 智能体上，出于效率考虑，设置了合理的 10 条结果上限。 然而，下游的格式化程序无法访问数据库中的结果总数，只能看到实际被获取的结果。 它在输出开头统计已获取的结果数量：“找到 10 份文档”。 在这项研究背后的生产事故中，实际有 191 份文档匹配该搜索，但输出中没有任何地方说明这一点。 输出中的每一句话在字面上都是真实的，但这份被截断的列表读起来就像是完整的结果集，而将其当作完整结果集来处理，导致一个智能体向用户提供了错误的信息。 维护者在日常开发中修复了那个格式化程序。 在撰写本研究论文时，还在 date_range_search 工具中发现了类似的缺陷：它最多获取 20 条结果，其格式化程序开头写着“找到 20 份文档”，而对于 1920 年，档案中实际有 4,772 条匹配；有 90 个不同年份的匹配数量超过了一次获取所能返回的数量。 第 3 节将研究该实例。

paragraphs.en: The third defect type is uncertainty, where the formatter is unclear about the degree of certainty of its results. For example, the find_in_document tool maps the character position of a match proportionally onto the document’s scans to estimate a page number. In an early draft caught in code review before merge, the formatter did not label it as an estimate, and an agent would have presented a guess as an exact page number, hurting user trust. We recreated it for testing and examine it in Section 3.
paragraphs.zh: 第三类缺陷是不确定性，即格式化工具不清楚其结果的确定程度。 例如，find_in_document 工具会将匹配项的字符位置按比例映射到文档的扫描页上，以估算页码。 在合并前代码审查中发现的早期草稿里，格式化工具未将其标注为估算值，智能体本会把猜测当作精确页码呈现，损害用户信任。 我们为测试目的重现了它，并在第 3 节中进行考察。

paragraphs.en: The last defect type is provenance, where the formatter does not explain where a piece of information came from. For example, our system had two types of numeric IDs, one for documents and one for page scans. These were simple integers and could easily be mistaken for one another. All but two of the 17,807 document IDs were also valid scan IDs for some unrelated item. If an agent trying to fetch a scan passed a document ID by mistake, the API would return a 200 OK along with a completely unrelated scan. Tool output presented these IDs without saying which numbering system each belonged to, creating ambiguity. That ambiguity caused a production incident: an agent cited a document ID as a scan, producing a valid-looking reference to the wrong item. Maintainers fixed that path before this study.
paragraphs.zh: 最后一种缺陷类型是溯源问题，即格式化工具没有解释某条信息来自哪里。 例如，我们的系统有两种数字 ID，一种用于文档，一种用于页面扫描件。 它们都是简单的整数，很容易被混淆。 在 17,807 个文档 ID 中，除两个以外，其余同时也是某些无关条目的有效扫描件 ID。 如果一个智能体在尝试获取扫描件时误传了文档 ID，API 会返回 200 OK，并附带一个完全无关的扫描件。 工具输出在展示这些 ID 时没有说明每个 ID 属于哪套编号体系，从而产生了歧义。 这种歧义引发了一起生产事故：一个智能体把文档 ID 当作扫描件 ID 引用，生成了一条看似有效却指向错误条目的引用。 维护者在本研究之前已修复了该路径。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 described four families of formatter defects. This section describes the experiment that measures what those defects do downstream. We ask whether warped wording makes agents claim more and verifiers accept more. The experiment uses one comparison: take a real implementation result, render it with two versions of the formatter, and observe what changes.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节描述了四类格式化器缺陷。 本节描述测量这些缺陷在下游造成何种影响的实验。 我们探究被扭曲的措辞是否会使智能体声称更多、使验证者接受更多。 该实验采用一次对比：取一个真实的实现结果，用格式化器的两个版本来渲染它，并观察发生什么变化。

sents.en: Section 2 described four families of formatter defects.
sents.zh: 第 2 节描述了四类格式化器缺陷。

paragraphs.en: The two conditions differ only in the rendered text, so paired changes can be traced to that text. Condition A carries the warped wording (some using the same warped formatters which were actually in production) and Condition B the clear wording that ships today. B reports the same result while disclosing its scope, completeness, uncertainty, and provenance. For some families the shipped wording also instructs the model how to handle the disclosure, so the measured effect belongs to the complete text, not the disclosures alone. We study the wording fix because the formatter is this paper’s subject, not because disclosure is always the best repair: for some defects a deeper fix, such as replacing the search cap with a more memory-efficient search algorithm, would be better engineering, and Section 5 discusses that choice. We freeze both texts by hash so nobody can revise them after seeing results. The authors wrote the scope and completeness fixes during the study; the uncertainty and provenance fixes predated it.
paragraphs.zh: 两种条件仅在渲染后的文本上不同，因此配对的差异可以归因于该文本。 条件 A 携带扭曲的措辞（部分使用当时实际在生产环境中使用的同样扭曲的格式化器），条件 B 携带如今发布的清晰措辞。 B 报告相同的结果，同时披露其范围、完整性、不确定性和来源。 对于某些语族，已发布的措辞还会指示模型如何处理披露内容，因此所测量的效果归属于完整文本，而不仅是披露内容本身。 我们研究措辞修复，是因为格式化器是本文的研究对象，而不是因为披露总是最佳修复方式：对于某些缺陷，更深层的修复（例如用内存效率更高的搜索算法替换搜索上限）会是更好的工程方案，第 5 节将讨论这一选择。 我们通过哈希值冻结两份文本，这样任何人都无法在看到结果后修改它们。 范围修复和完整性修复由作者在研究期间完成；不确定性修复和来源修复则早于研究。

paragraphs.en: A case is one concrete tool call with a known correct answer. For example, one scope case searches one specific document for a term that occurs only past the million-character cap. We derive 40 cases, 10 per defect family, from reproduced database facts using deterministic rules. We use 8 cases to tune the instrument and exclude them from the primary analysis, so we cannot tune toward cases we practice on. The other 32 form the holdout set. 1 1 1 Only 7 documents in the archive can support a scope case (long enough to exceed the cap, with a term occurring only beyond it), so with 10 scope cases, some documents serve more than one, and one document ended up with a case on each side of the tuning/holdout split. Since tuning could in principle have taught us something about that document, we committed in advance to also reporting the analysis with its holdout case dropped; Section 4 shows the results are unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 一个案例（case）是指一次带有已知正确答案的具体工具调用。 例如，一个范围案例（scope case）是在某个特定文档中检索一个仅出现在百万字符上限之后的词。 我们基于复现的数据库事实，使用确定性规则推导出 40 个案例，每个缺陷族 10 个。 我们使用 8 个案例来调试工具，并将其排除在主要分析之外，因此我们无法针对正在练习的案例进行调试。 其余 32 个案例构成留出集。¹ ¹ ¹ 档案中只有 7 个文档能够支持一个范围案例（足够长以致超过上限，且有一个词仅出现在上限之后），因此在 10 个范围案例中，一些文档被用于多个案例，且有一个文档在调试/留出划分的两侧各有一个案例。 由于调试在原则上可能让我们了解该文档的一些信息，我们事先承诺还会报告剔除其留出案例后的分析结果；第 4 节表明结果没有变化。

paragraphs.en: We freeze the grading rules after the pilot rounds and before the final experiment, so what counts as an error is settled before we see any answer it will be applied to. For each case, we list in advance which claims an answer may make and which are forbidden. A claim is forbidden when the database falsifies it or the evidence cannot support it. We accept hedging: a qualification anywhere in an answer keeps a claim from being forbidden when it covers the cited value. Two model graders from different vendors, Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, independently assess every answer for overclaim. Unlike the frequency verifiers, graders may share the agent’s vendor. When they agree, that shared verdict is the grade. When they disagree, an author decides using the claim lists, and we report how often that happened. Model graders and verifiers run at temperature 0.0 to minimize sampling variation. In the final pilot, an AI research assistant blindly regraded all 64 transcripts and matched the consensus on all 64. A human author independently graded 12 transcripts and matched it on 10/12; the two divergences were context failures that we repaired. After the full run, a human author blindly graded the prespecified 40-answer sample and matched the consensus on 35 of the 36 answers from the three models reported here (the other four sampled answers came from a model run not reported in this paper). In the one divergence, the human graded a hedged page estimate as an overclaim, a stricter reading than the frozen claim list allows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在试评轮次之后、最终实验之前冻结评分规则，因此在看到任何将被应用的答案之前，“什么算作错误”就已确定。 对于每个案例，我们预先列出答案可以做出哪些论断、哪些论断是被禁止的。 当数据库证伪某个论断、或证据无法支持该论断时，该论断即被禁止。 我们接受限定性表述：只要答案中任意位置的限定语覆盖了所引用的数值，该论断就不会被判定为禁止。 两名来自不同厂商的模型评分器——Claude Sonnet 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol——独立评估每个答案是否存在过度声称。 与频率验证器不同，评分器可以与智能体来自同一厂商。 当两者意见一致时，该一致结论即为评分。 当两者意见不一致时，由一位作者依据论断列表做出裁决，并且我们报告这种情况发生的频率。 模型评分器和验证器均在温度 0.0 下运行，以尽量减少抽样波动。 在最终试评中，一名 AI 研究助手对全部 64 份记录进行了盲评，并与共识在全部 64 份上完全一致。 一位人类作者独立评阅了 12 份记录，其中 10/12 与之一致；两处分歧属于上下文失效问题，我们已将其修复。 在完整运行之后，一位人类作者对预先指定的 40 个答案样本进行了盲评，在本文所报告的三个模型的 36 个答案中，有 35 个与共识一致（另外 4 个被抽样的答案来自本文未报告的某次模型运行）。 在唯一一处分歧中，该人类作者将一个带有限定语的页面估计判定为过度声称，这比冻结的论断列表所允许的解读更为严格。

paragraphs.en: We measured the verifiers to see two things: causality and frequency. The first measurement (depicted in Figure 2 ) we call the fixed-answer measure. It asks whether the wording from the formatter alone changes verdicts. A false acceptance is a SUPPORTED verdict on an answer that contains a forbidden claim. For each case, we wrote one false answer asserting that case’s forbidden claim, then showed that false answer to the verifier with tool output formatting from two versions of the formatter: the warped version and the clear version. Because nothing else varies, any change in the paired verdicts is caused by the formatter. All three verifiers judge every case under both conditions, producing 240 verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对校验器进行了测量，以考察两点：因果性和频率。 第一项测量（如图 2 所示）我们称为固定答案测量。 它询问的是，仅格式化器的措辞是否会改变判定结果。 虚假接受是指对一个包含禁止性声明的答案给出 SUPPORTED 判定。 对于每个案例，我们撰写一个断言该案例禁止性声明的虚假答案，然后将该虚假答案连同来自两个版本格式化器的工具输出格式展示给校验器：扭曲版本和清晰版本。 由于其他因素均保持不变，成对判定中的任何变化都是由格式化器引起的。 三个校验器在两种条件下都对每个案例进行判定，共产生 240 个判定结果。

paragraphs.en: The second measurement of the verifier, the one for frequency, tells us how often false acceptance happens on the answers agents actually wrote. The setup matches Figure 2 except that the judged answer is the agent’s real one, and no verifier judges an answer from its own vendor. This measure does not show causality. The two wordings produce different answers, and a verifier can reject an answer for an unrelated defect.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器的第二次测量，即针对频率的那一次，告诉我们错误接受在智能体实际写出的答案上发生的频率。 实验设置与图 2 一致，不同之处在于被评判的答案是智能体的真实答案，并且没有任何验证器评判来自其自身供应商的答案。 这一指标并不显示因果关系。 两种措辞会产生不同的答案，而且验证器可能因一个无关的缺陷而拒绝某个答案。

paragraphs.en: To test whether these failures persisted when verifiers had additional evidence and a different judging task, we took 46 false answers agents actually wrote under the warped wording and judged each under every combination of two questions (supported vs. correct) and two evidence levels (tool output alone vs. with the verified facts). The two questions matter because a verifier asked only whether an answer is supported may rightly ignore facts beyond the tool output. Asking for correctness gives the added facts a fair chance. Success in this control would show that these models can reject these answers under the enriched conditions, without establishing reliability on other cases.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验当验证者拥有额外证据和不同的评判任务时这些失败是否仍然存在，我们选取了智能体在扭曲措辞下实际写出的46个错误答案，并在两个问题（是否有依据 vs. 是否正确）和两个证据水平（仅工具输出 vs. 附带已核实事实）的每种组合下对每个答案进行评判。 这两个问题之所以重要，是因为被问及某个答案是否有依据的验证者，可能合理地忽略工具输出之外的事实。 要求判断正确性则给了这些附加事实一个公平的机会。 在这一对照中取得成功将表明这些模型能够在增强条件下拒绝这些答案，但并不能确立其在其他情形下的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Before we interpret any model behavior, we check that the two wordings really differ in the way we claim: disclosures are absent from every warped text, and are present in every clear one. A deterministic checker tests all 80 texts and flags 40/40 warped and 0/40 clear versions. We prespecify exclusions for API errors, truncations, refusals, and grading failures, then count and report each type. We also seed the execution order and the 40 answers sampled for human grading so both can be reproduced.
paragraphs.zh: 在解释任何模型行为之前，我们先检查两种措辞确实以我们所声称的方式存在差异：扭曲文本中全部不含披露内容，而清晰文本中全部含有披露内容。 一个确定性检查器测试全部 80 篇文本，标记出 40/40 的扭曲版本和 0/40 的清晰版本。 我们预先规定排除 API 错误、截断、拒答和评分失败的情形，然后对每一类进行统计并报告。 我们还对执行顺序以及抽样的 40 个供人工评分的答案设置了随机种子，以便二者均可复现。

paragraphs.en: Clear wording sharply reduced agent overclaim for scope, completeness, and uncertainty, while identifier provenance changed little (Figure 3 ). Under the warped wording, agents overclaimed on 62-100% of answers depending on family; the clear wording cut scope, completeness, and uncertainty to 8%, 0%, and 20%, while provenance stayed at 94%. The effects are +62 to +92 percentage points for the three repaired families against +6 for provenance, with 95% cluster bootstrap intervals and exact counts in Appendix C , Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 清晰的措辞显著减少了智能体在范围、完整性和不确定性方面的过度宣称，而标识符来源几乎未变（图 3）。 在扭曲的措辞下，智能体在不同模型系列的 62–100% 的回答上存在过度宣称；清晰措辞将范围、不确定性和过度宣称分别降至 8%、0% 和 20%，而来源仍保持在 94%。 三个被修复系列的效应为 +62 至 +92 个百分点，而来源仅为 +6，95% 聚类自助法置信区间和精确计数见附录 C 表 3。

paragraphs.en: Agents sometimes repaired an incomplete count themselves, but they also stripped qualifications from estimates. Completeness remained at 62% under A because the grading rules permit search-scoped counts (“the search returned 20” or “found 20”), but forbid archive-wide totals. Figure 1 illustrates a count change, not an overclaim transition: one grader flagged A, but the second grader and human adjudication found no forbidden claim. The figure reports the final grade. Uncertainty retained a 20% overclaim rate under the clear wording through estimate laundering. The tool line labels its guess (“ESTIMATED page 8 of 14 … proportional estimate, NOT a confirmed page”) but the same line also names the matching archive page (149), derived from the same guess; answers hedged the labeled number and stated the archive page as fact (wording in Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Clear wording reversed verifier judgments for scope, completeness, and uncertainty. In the fixed-answer measure the answer stays fixed and only the formatter’s wording differs, so any verdict change is caused by the wording. Provenance again moved little, from 18/30 (60%) to 14/30 (47%).

paragraphs.en: Verifiers rejected all selected overclaims only when they had both the missing facts and the correctness question (Table 2 ). The control judged 46 warped-wording false answers from the scope and completeness families, using each model’s first answer per case, each judged by two cross-vendor verifiers. Changing the question alone did not reduce false acceptance, and facts alone helped partly; together they eliminated false acceptance in these selected cases. This control establishes that both evidence and task framing matter under the tested conditions; it does not establish general verifier competence.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当核验者同时拥有缺失事实和正确性问题时，才会拒绝所有被选中的过度声明（表 2）。 对照组对来自范围类和完整性类的 46 个扭曲措辞的错误回答进行了判定，使用每个模型在每个案例中的首次回答，每个回答由两名跨厂商的核验者判定。 仅改变问题并未降低错误接受率，仅提供事实有部分帮助；二者结合在这些被选中的案例中消除了错误接受。 该对照实验表明，在所测试的条件下，证据和任务框架都很重要；它并不能证明核验者具有普遍能力。

These rates do not support a causal comparison because the conditions select different answers and a verifier may reject an answer for another defect.
paragraphs.zh: 频率统计显示，在范围、完整性和不确定性三类中，校验器接受了大多数带有扭曲措辞的过度声明答案，在来源类中则接受了一半（表 2）。 这些比率不能支持因果比较，因为各条件选择了不同的答案，而且校验器可能因其他缺陷而拒绝某个答案。

paragraphs.en: The two model graders usually agreed on whether an answer overclaimed. The different-vendor judge and meta-judge agreed on 1,147/1,199 dually graded answers (96%). Human adjudication resolved 53 answers: 52 disagreements and one answer with a single valid grade after the other grader’s output failed validation. Rulings were resolved against the pre-written label sheets. No run from the reported models met the prespecified exclusion rules. Section 3 reports the calibration agreement and identifies its AI and human sources.

paragraphs.en: State what the tool actually searched, including any limit that left material unexamined.
paragraphs.zh: 说明该工具实际检索了什么内容，包括任何导致部分材料未被检索的限制条件。

paragraphs.en: For an anecdotal demonstration that finding them is practical, we wrote and froze a short audit prompt while already knowing the source system’s defects, then gave it to the off-the-shelf coding-agent harnesses Codex and Claude Code. 2 2 2 Both received the pre-fix source tree without version-control history, and the Codex runs had the agent’s persistent memory disabled. Claude Code loads user-level instructions that cannot be disabled; we verified that they contain nothing about the system.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个表明找出这些缺陷切实可行的非正式演示，我们在已经知晓该源系统缺陷的情况下编写并冻结了一份简短的审计提示词，然后将其交给现成的智能体编程框架 Codex 和 Claude Code。 2 2 2 两者都收到了没有版本控制历史的修复前源代码树，并且 Codex 的运行禁用了智能体的持久记忆。 Claude Code 会加载无法禁用的用户级指令；我们核实了其中不包含任何关于该系统的内容。

paragraphs.en: Each harness independently rediscovered both defects that were live at that commit and did not flag the two already-fixed families. Together they reported twelve distinct additional instances of warped formatting outside our catalogue, including a formatter for the semantic_search tool that silently returned three of five results the tool retrieved. Adversarial model reviewers, models prompted to refute each finding, confirmed the discrepancies in substance, although two had a detail downgraded.

paragraphs.en: LLM judges can track human preferences, but their verdicts remain sensitive to what they see and how it is presented. G-Eval prompts GPT-4 to score generated text, while MT-Bench compares LLM judgments with human preferences and reports position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases [Liu et al., 2023b; Zheng et al., 2023]. Changing candidate-response order can reverse an LLM judge’s comparison, and meaning-preserving prompt formats can produce large changes in task accuracy [Wang et al., 2023; Sclar et al., 2023]. Training-example order and the position of relevant evidence within a long context also affect model performance [Zhao et al., 2021; Liu et al., 2023c]. The warped formatting appears inside the tool output, before the agent writes an answer and the verifier judges it.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 评判者能够追踪人类偏好，但其判定仍然对所看到的内容及其呈现方式很敏感。 G-Eval 让 GPT-4 为生成的文本打分，而 MT-Bench 则将 LLM 的判断与人类偏好进行比较，并报告了位置偏差、冗长偏差和自我增强偏差 [Liu et al., 2023b; Zheng et al., 2023]。 改变候选回答的顺序可能会反转 LLM 评判者的比较结果，而保留语义的提示词格式也可能导致任务准确率发生巨大变化 [Wang et al., 2023; Sclar et al., 2023]。 训练样本的顺序以及相关证据在长上下文中的位置也会影响模型性能 [Zhao et al., 2021; Liu et al., 2023c]。 被扭曲的格式出现在工具输出内部，位于智能体写出答案和验证者进行评判之前。

paragraphs.en: Groundedness metrics judge claims against supplied text. FEVER verifies claims against retrieved Wikipedia evidence, while FActScore measures the share of atomic facts supported by a knowledge source [Thorne et al., 2018; Min et al., 2023]. The hallucination literature defines faithfulness relative to provided source content [Ji et al., 2022]. RAG conditions generation on retrieved passages, and Ragas measures faithfulness to retrieved context [Lewis et al., 2020; Es et al., 2023]. When retrieved text passes through warped formatting, these methods cannot grade a boundary or qualification that the formatter omitted.
paragraphs.zh: 有据性指标将论断与所提供的文本进行对照评判。 FEVER 依据检索到的维基百科证据验证论断，而 FActScore 衡量被知识来源支持的原子事实所占比例 [Thorne et al., 2018; Min et al., 2023]。 幻觉相关文献将忠实性定义为相对于所提供的源内容而言 [Ji et al., 2022]。 RAG 使生成以检索到的段落为条件，Ragas 则衡量对检索上下文的忠实度 [Lewis et al., 2020; Es et al., 2023]。 当检索到的文本经过失真的格式转换后，这些方法无法对格式化工具所遗漏的边界或限定条件进行评分。

paragraphs.en: GroundEval records and deterministically scores agent trajectories while treating the tool layer as trusted ground truth [Flynt, 2026]. NabaOS checks agent claims against signed tool receipts, while conceding that a receipt remains valid when the data behind it is wrong [Basu, 2026]. FORCE-Bench uses rubrics to assess whether an agent’s behavior is grounded in the returns supplied by its tools [Pauli et al., 2026]. AgentAssay detects behavioral drift across repeated runs instead of testing whether a formatter faithfully represents hidden state [Bhardwaj, 2026]. Anchor derives the instruction, oracle, and verifier from one specification, keeping those benchmark components aligned at creation [Ivanov and Rana, 2026]. ContractBench measures whether agents preserve tool-provided artifacts with syntactic fidelity as they carry them into later actions [Wang et al., 2026]. These methods begin their checks at the formatter boundary or farther downstream. None compares what the tool did with what its formatter’s words tell the model.
paragraphs.zh: GroundEval 在将工具层视为可信基准事实 [Flynt, 2026] 的同时，记录并确定性地为智能体轨迹评分。 NabaOS 通过签名的工具回执来核验智能体的声明，同时承认即使回执背后的数据有误，回执仍然有效 [Basu, 2026]。 FORCE-Bench 使用评分标准来评估智能体的行为是否立足于其工具所提供的返回结果 [Pauli et al., 2026]。 AgentAssay 检测多次运行之间的行为漂移，而不是测试格式化器是否忠实地表示了隐藏状态 [Bhardwaj, 2026]。 Anchor 从同一份规范中导出指令、预言机和验证器，使这些基准测试组件在创建时就保持一致 [Ivanov and Rana, 2026]。 ContractBench 衡量智能体在将工具提供的产物带入后续操作时，是否以语法保真度保存这些产物 [Wang et al., 2026]。 这些方法的检查都从格式化器边界或更下游的位置开始。 没有一种方法将工具实际做了什么与它的格式化器的文字向模型传达的信息进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The audit-prompt exercise in Section 5 carries separate limits. The system’s authors ran it using a prompt written by people who already knew the defects. For the runs on our own system’s snapshot, Codex ran with persistent memory disabled, because we voided an initial launch after the agent read its own notes about the system. The Claude Code harness loads user-level instructions that cannot be disabled; we verified that those instructions contain nothing about the system. Adversarial model reviewers supplied the confirmation for the additional discrepancies on our own system; a human author reviewed a selection, not all. The two upstream findings received human review: we reviewed both before filing, and a maintainer’s merge independently confirmed the OpenClaw fix. The exercise remains an unevaluated demonstration. paragraphs.en: Much of what misled our agents and verifiers was never the model. It was a warped formatter nobody had checked.

paragraphs.en: We compared warped wording with clear wording while holding each tool result fixed. Agents made far fewer unsupported claims from the clear wording in the scope, completeness, and uncertainty families, while provenance changed little. Verifiers reversed their verdicts on the same false answers under the clear wording, and the control showed why: given the verified facts and asked about correctness, they rejected all selected false answers in the scope and completeness control. This result is limited to those cases, models, and prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在各工具结果保持不变的情况下，比较了扭曲措辞与清晰措辞。 在范围、完整性和不确定性类别中，智能体在清晰措辞下做出的无依据断言大幅减少，而来源归属变化不大。 在清晰措辞下，验证者对同样的错误答案推翻了原有判定，对照组说明了原因：在给定已验证事实并被问及正确性时，他们否定了范围和完整性对照组中所有被选出的错误答案。 这一结果仅限于上述案例、模型和提示词。

paragraphs.en: Who verifies the tools? Our findings show the need to compare what the tool did with what its output formatter actually tells the model.
paragraphs.zh: 谁来验证这些工具？ 我们的研究结果表明，需要将工具实际执行的操作与其输出格式化程序实际告知模型的内容进行对比。
